stem: In a driving simulator study, what was the effect of restricting adolescents to 6.5 hours of sleep over five nights compared with 10 hours of sleep?

options.text: It impaired performance only when sleep was reduced below 4 hours
It produced no measurable difference in performance
It slightly improved performance because of increased adrenaline
It improved performance because adolescents adapted within five nights

explanation: Significant impairment in performance is the correct answer. Restricting adolescents to 6.5 hours of sleep over five nights reduced driving simulator performance compared with 10 hours of sleep.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because the study found that 6.5 hours of sleep over five nights significantly worsened adolescent performance compared with 10 hours of sleep.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because the study showed impairment at 6.5 hours, not only at extreme sleep loss below 4 hours.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because there was a measurable decrement in simulator performance with sleep restriction.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because sleep restriction worsens attention and reaction time rather than improving driving performance.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because adolescents did not fully adapt within five nights; performance remained worse with restricted sleep.

source.hint: Recall the specific hourly durations mentioned in the US simulator studies.
